items.description:
##Current shipping forecast##

Valid for 24 HoursIssued on Wednesday, 22 July 2026 at 7:30am by Ronaldsway Met Office
##Warning##

Strong winds.


##Synopsis##

High pressure to the west of Ireland extending a ridge across the Irish Sea.


##Wind##

North or northwest 3 to 5, but occasionally 6 in the west of the area for a time this morning. Then becoming 4 or 5 in most waters this evening, but occasionally 6 to the west and southwest of the Isle of Man at first tonight.


##State of Sea##

Slight occasionally moderate.


##Weather##

Fair.


##Visibility##

Good.


##Outlook for the following 24 hours##


##Wind##

North or northwest 3 to 5, backing west 3 or 4 by dawn on Friday.


##State of Sea##

Slight, becoming smooth or slight later.


##Weather##

Fair.


##Visibility##

Good.
